name: MFCL Vision
description: The first large-scale benchmark for vision-based function calling in multimodal large language models, featuring 250 expert-verified tasks across five image domains and five query types, with exact-match evaluation and controlled visual perturbations.
reputation: A very recent, specialized benchmark from the paper introducing vision-based function calling, so it is not yet widely adopted but is notable as an early benchmark in this niche.
notes: Includes human-produced reasoning traces and a taxonomy of failure modes; uses a singular web-search tool for evaluation.
